answer: Watch the rhythm, not the résumé. Each wallet leaves a tempo: when it wakes, which fee band it picks, whose addresses it touches. A clone farm echoes one heartbeat across a thousand names, and correlation exposes what any single mask hides. So weight accounts by behavioral divergence — a lone address may be hollow as a lotus seed, yet if its pulse never duplicates a neighbor's, it earns trust; a sybil army must then afford a thousand rehearsed personalities, each a full invented life.
